Which of the following could be the function that generates the vector field above?
worked_solution:
We notice the following:

- The vertical component (i.e., the $j$ component) is zero for each vector in our vector field. Therefore, we can rule out the following options:

$$
G(x,y)=j,\,F(x,y)=-j
$$

- The horizontal component (i.e., the $i$ component) is positive for each vector in our vector field. Therefore, we can rule out the following option:

$$
H(x,y)=-i
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $K(x,y)=i.$
